== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns William McCaughey. The reproduced Third Portglenone Presbyterian marriage list records Robert Elder, full-age bachelor labourer of Ballymoney, marrying Jane Adams McCaughey, full-age spinster of Garvaghey, on 13 July 1887. Robert's father is recorded as James Elder, labourer; Jane's father as William McCaughey, labourer.<ref>RootsChat, Elder, Murdoch & McMeekin Families; [https://www.rootschat.com/forum/index.php?topic=214109.0 record].</ref> The witnesses were Archie McCaughey and Lizzie Connaghy. This Robert is distinct from Mary Glasgow’s 1871 husband, Robert Elder, whose father was Nathaniel Elder and whose occupation was farmer. The source is a secondary transcription and the original register remains to be inspected. The identification remains uncertain. His estimated birth about 1750 creates severe generational difficulty for identifying him as father of the full-age 1887 bride. The sparse family-history account gives no daughter or locality connecting the two.
